summary: The staff rejects the request to defer licensing, concluding it is not in the public interest to wait for studies that may affect load forecasts, as projections have already been made on the most reliable available information; flow augmentation and stream habitat impacts are addressed in revised sections.
text: Staff concludes that it is not in the best interest of the public to defer the processing of this application until studies are completed which may affect or modify load forecasts which have been made on the bacis of the most reliable information already available at this time.
